title: From Melting Pots to Misrepresentations: Exploring Harms in Generative AI
benchmark_measurement: The paper uses an anecdotal example of generating an image of a 'pope' to discuss misrepresentation and what some social media users termed a 'pro-diversity bias' in image generation models.
findings: The paper cites a viral incident where the Gemini model, when prompted for an image of a 'pope', generated images perceived as non-traditional (e.g., a Black woman). This example is used to illustrate the broader issue of misrepresentation and the public backlash against what some users called an injected 'pro-diversity bias', highlighting the complex challenges in representing identities in generative AI.
